root_text.title: කාක ජාතකය
root_text.author: A.P. de Zoysa
root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 15. කකණ්ටක වර්ගය

146. කාක ජාතකය

Msdiv 146අපගේ වනාහි හකුදෙක ශාන්තයහ. මුඛයද වියලෙහි වීර්ය කරම්හයි දිය අදුම්හ. වීර්ය කොට කෙළවරකට නොයා හැක්කම්හ. සමුද්‍රය ඉඩ පමණින් පිරේම යැයි” කීයේය.

සමුද්දකාකජාතකං ඡට්ඨං.

AP de Zoysa edition.

suttaplex.blurb: “Our throats are tired.”—This story was told by the Master while at Jetavana, about a number of aged Brethren. Whilst they were still of the world, they were rich and wealthy squires of Savatthi, all friends of one another; and tradition tells us that while they were engaged in good works they heard the Master preach. At once they cried, “We are old; what to us are house and home? Let us join the Brotherhood, and following the Buddha’s lovely doctrine make an end of sorrow.”
